title: 第36章 他是真的不在乎了

第36章 他是真的不在乎了-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

林国强打开院门，赵志军站在门口，围着那条灰色围巾，戴着黑皮手套，鼻子冻得红通通的，嘴里哈着白气。

“你这么早来干啥？”

“今天你们家上坟不，我来帮忙拿东西。”赵志军搓了搓手，“三姐呢？”

其实他是闲着在家没事干，想来三姐夫家蹭饭吃。

“还没起。”

“那我先进来等着。”

赵志军缩着脖子进了院子，看见那辆永久自行车，眼睛亮了一下，“三姐夫，你这车真好看。”

“是不赖。”林国强从灶台边拿出几个馒头，放进锅里蒸上，“吃了没？”

“没呢。”

“正好，一起吃点。”

赵素梅被说话声吵醒了，披着棉袄从屋里出来。

看见赵志军，她愣了一下：“志军，你咋来了？”

“在家闲着没事，过来看看你们。”

赵志军不好意思的搓搓手。

赵素梅点了点头，转身进屋去给两个孩子穿衣服。

吃完早饭，林国强把供品装进篮子里。

几个馒头、一盘饺子、一碟花生米、一块猪肉，还有一瓶酒。

赵素梅又往篮子里塞了一刀黄纸和一挂鞭炮。

“东西都带齐了？”她问。

“齐了。”

“那你们去吧，我和静静薇薇就不去了，天冷，别冻着。”

林国强点了点头，提着篮子出了门。

赵志军跟在后面，两个人一前一后地往村北的坟地走去。

村北的坟地在山坡上，要走二十多分钟。

路上已经有人了，三三两两的，都提着篮子往同一个方向走。

雪地上踩出了一条路，被脚底板碾得瓷实，滑溜溜的，一不小心就要栽跟头。

还好赵素梅和两个孩子没跟来。

到林家坟地的时候，林海柱已经到了。

他穿着一件旧棉袄，蹲在祖坟前，正在用袖子擦墓碑上的雪。

旁边站着林国伟和林国栋，两个人手里都提着篮子，脸色不太好。

林美丽也在，穿着一件新棉袄，站在林海柱身后，手里拿着一刀黄纸。

Lin Guoqiang opened the courtyard door, and Zhao Zhijun stood at the door, wearing a gray scarf and black leather gloves, his nose was red from the cold, and his mouth was breathing white.

"What are you doing here so early?"

"Would you like to visit the grave today? I'll help you get the things." Zhao Zhijun rubbed his hands, "Where's Third Sister?"

In fact, he had nothing to do at home and wanted to come to his third brother-in-law's house to have a meal.

"Not up yet."

"Then I'll come in first and wait."

Zhao Zhijun hunched his neck and entered the yard. When he saw the permanent bicycle, his eyes lit up, "Third brother-in-law, your car is so beautiful."

"It's not bad." Lin Guoqiang took out a few steamed buns from the stove and put them in the pot to steam them. "Have you eaten yet?"

"Nothing."

"That's right, let's have some together."

Zhao Sumei was awakened by the sound of voices and came out of the house wearing a cotton-padded jacket.

Seeing Zhao Zhijun, she was stunned for a moment: "Zhijun, why are you here?"

"I have nothing to do at home, so I came to see you."

Zhao Zhijun rubbed his hands in embarrassment.

Zhao Sumei nodded, turned around and went into the house to dress the two children.

After breakfast, Lin Guoqiang put the offerings into the basket.

A few steamed buns, a plate of dumplings, a plate of peanuts, a piece of pork, and a bottle of wine.

Zhao Sumei stuffed another knife of yellow paper and a hanging firecracker into the basket.

"Have you brought everything?" she asked.

"It's all ready."

"Then you go, Jingjing Weiwei and I won't go. It's cold, don't freeze."

Lin Guoqiang nodded and carried the basket out the door.

Zhao Zhijun followed, and the two of them walked to the cemetery in the north of the village one after another.

The cemetery in the north of the village is on a hillside, and it takes more than 20 minutes to walk.

There were already people on the road, in twos and threes, all carrying baskets and walking in the same direction.

A path was made on the snow, and the soles of the feet were ground to a solid surface, making it slippery. If you were not careful, you would fall down.

Fortunately, Zhao Sumei and the two children did not follow.

When they arrived at the Lin family cemetery, Lin Haizhu had already arrived.

He was wearing an old cotton-padded jacket, squatting in front of his ancestor's grave, wiping the snow on the tombstone with his sleeves.

Lin Guowei and Lin Guodong stood next to them. Both of them were holding baskets in their hands and their expressions were not good.

Lin Meili was also there, wearing a new cotton-padded jacket, standing behind Lin Haizhu, holding a knife of yellow paper in his hand.
